ExperimentSubset: notes for coding agents

Source: AGENTS.md

The shared development standards (r-bioc-dev-standards) load automatically at session start in Claude Code. This file adds only what is specific to this package. Other agents (for example through GEMINI.md) don’t get them automatically: read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/campbio/r-bioc-dev-standards/v1/standards.md (or the cached copy in ~/.cache/r-bioc-dev-standards/v1/) before starting, and follow it; those agents also aren’t bound by .claude/settings.json.

In Claude Code, if the standards aren’t in your context at session start, this clone has no .claude/settings.json, so neither the standards nor the permission guardrails are active: stop, and ask the developer to run make claude-setup in a terminal outside Claude Code (not with !, which runs inside it and is refused), then restart claude.

About

ExperimentSubset adds subset support to Bioconductor Experiment objects: many subsets of the same data (rows, columns, and their own assays, rowData, colData, reducedDims, and so on) live inside one object instead of separate copies. Supported classes are SummarizedExperiment, RangedSummarizedExperiment, SingleCellExperiment, TreeSummarizedExperiment and SpatialExperiment. Distributed through Bioconductor since 3.12. There is no Shiny app, so that part of the standards doesn’t apply.

The pkgdown site is at https://campbio.github.io/ExperimentSubset/: the release version at the root, the devel version under /dev/. CI builds and deploys both (.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml, ADR 0002); never build or deploy the site locally. Add new exports to _pkgdown.yml and run make site-check.

Layout

  • R/allClasses.R: the S4 classes (see Object model).
  • R/allGenerics.R: every package generic, with its roxygen docs and examples.
  • R/ExperimentSubset.R: the ExperimentSubset() constructor, which wraps an input object in the matching Subset*Experiment class (a plain list of assays becomes a SubsetSingleCellExperiment) and can create a first subset through subset =, plus the shared internal implementations (.createSubset(), .setSubsetAssay(), .subsetParent(), …) and the internal slot accessors.
  • R/Subset<Class>.R, one per supported class: thin setMethod() wrappers that forward to the shared internals. A change to a method usually needs the same change in all five files.
  • Collate: in DESCRIPTION fixes the load order (classes, then generics, then the rest). Add new R files there too.
  • vignettes/ExperimentSubset.Rmd, with the figure es_structure.png: the short Bioconductor vignette, which is the site’s “Get started” page.
  • vignettes/articles/: longer pkgdown-only articles, not in the Bioconductor build (.Rbuildignore). Their packages go in Config/Needs/website in DESCRIPTION, not Suggests. Render one with make article FILTER=<name>, which needs the package installed.
  • Style: the code uses 2-space indentation, set in .lintr (indentation_linter(indent = 2L)). Converting to 4 spaces would be a separate maintainer decision and its own PR.

Object model

  • AssaySubset (internal): one subset. Slots subsetName, rowIndices and colIndices (indices into the parent), parentAssay (the name of the assay or subset it was made from, so subsets can chain), and internalAssay (a SummarizedExperiment-like object holding the subset’s own assays and metadata).
  • SubsetSummarizedExperiment, SubsetRangedSummarizedExperiment, SubsetSingleCellExperiment, SubsetTreeSummarizedExperiment and SubsetSpatialExperiment: each extends its Bioconductor class with one slot, subsets, a SimpleList of AssaySubset.
  • Never use @. Inside the package, use the internal accessors in R/ExperimentSubset.R (.subsets(), .subsets<-, .subsetName(), .rowIndices(), .colIndices(), .parentAssay(), .internalAssay(), .internalAssay<-). Users see the exported API (createSubset(), setSubsetAssay(), getSubsetAssay(), subsetNames(), subsetRowData(), subsetColData(), …) and the base methods (assay(), reducedDims(), metadata(), altExps()) called with subsetName =.

Tests

  • One file, tests/testthat/test-ExperimentSubset.R (testthat edition 2, with context()), so make test-one FILTER=ExperimentSubset runs the whole suite.
  • It runs offline: a small simulated data set stands in for the PBMC data the vignette downloads.
  • The whole file skips when scds (for sce_chcl) is missing; tests that need airway, scrapper or scater skip on their own.

Extra make targets

None.

Setup in a new worktree

  • Install every package in Suggests (devtools::install_dev_deps()); checks don’t relax missing Suggests.
  • DESCRIPTION has RoxygenNote: 7.1.1. make docs with a current roxygen2 rewrites every file in man/ and updates that field. Keep such a refresh in its own PR rather than mixing it into a functional change.

Related packages

None. No Bioconductor package depends on, imports or suggests ExperimentSubset.

Overrides

None.
